newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar says fire erupts at L.A. prods tank.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar says fire erupts at L.A. prods tank.

text.p: Ultramar Corp said on Thursday a small fire broke out around 1415 PDT/2115 GMT in a 20,000- barrel storage tank at its marine terminal on the Port of Los Angeles.
"There was a small fire in a tank in a marine terminal," a company spokesman told Reuters, adding the fire was extinguished.
The company said around 8,000 barrels of raw diesel and jet fuel were stored in the tank when the fire erupted.
The marine terminal, which handles both crude and refined products, contains 15 to 20 storage tanks and connects to Ultramar's nearby Wilmington, Calif., refinery.
The refinery manufactures about 100,000 bpd of refined products.
The company said it was did not know if supplies to the refinery would be disrupted.
